issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) requires the Animal constructor and the name getter/setter to have protected visibility, but the solution implements them as public. This discrepancy can confuse students about the expected access level for these members and may lead to tests or grading expectations mismatching student implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the specification by changing the Animal constructor and the getName/setName methods to protected in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java, or alternatively update the problem statement and UML to require public visibility for these methods/constructor. Preferably adjust the solution to use protected visibility to match the stated UML and instructions.
